title: 第3章 偷盗灵谷第4章 种植灵谷
content_zh:
;;
“偷”这个念头进入陈平的脑子，留在那里。
恐惧抓住了他，让他手脚冰凉。
但紧接着，是饿了三年后生出的疯狂。
不偷，就会饿死。
偷了，万一真能种出来呢？
万一这片黑土可以呢？
他想起白天削的那根硬木棍。
那是他从废料堆里捡的一截边角，又硬又韧。
他花了半天，用那块边缘锋利的碎石片，削去毛刺和树皮，磨得光滑些。原本打算防身或撬东西。
现在，这根一尺长的硬木棍，成了他唯一的工具。
他回到窝棚。
天已经亮了，窝棚区嘈杂起来，咳嗽声、叫骂声混在一起。
陈平攥紧那根硬木棍，木纹硌着他的手心。他把它塞进裤腰，用外衣盖住。
他需要等待时机。
白天人多，不行。
目标只能是夜晚看守较松的灵田外围。那里种的灵谷物，品阶低，看守也没那么严。
没人相信这些饿得半死的苦力，敢动仙师的东西。
一整天，陈平在煎熬和亢奋中度过。
他和其他人一样，干着活，拉车，搬石料，清废渣。

肚子很饿，但更折磨的是那个念头和怀里的玉佩。每一次弯腰，他都下意识护着那里，怕人看出异样。
手上早有老茧，干活还算正常。只是拇指上被石片划开的口子，隐隐作痛，提醒他昨晚的事。
他不敢再看玉佩，只想着夜晚。
终于收工了。
监工分发了那点米饭。
陈平狼吞虎咽，强迫自己不去想饿，只想那片黑土。
夜幕再次降临。
陈平蜷在窝棚最黑的角落，听着外面。
人声渐渐少了，只剩零星的咳嗽和远处的虫鸣。
时间过去。
陈平心跳得很快。他估算巡逻的守卫刚走过这片，下一轮要半个时辰后。这是他的机会。
他悄声爬起来，没惊动窝棚里其他睡着的人。
他摸到门边，听了听，推开一条缝，侧身出去，又把门掩好。
夜风吹在背上，有点凉。
窝棚区很静，远处偶尔有狗叫。
他贴着窝棚的阴影，朝外围灵田的方向走。
月光很淡，云遮着，地面朦胧。这给了他掩护。
路不平，他深一脚浅一脚，尽量不发出声音。每次踩到东西，都立刻停下，伏低身体，确认没动静才继续。
走了一刻钟，空气里灵谷的清香浓了起来。
他看到了灵田的轮廓，在月光下，灵稻像一片黑色的毯子。

田埂边有个草棚。守夜人待的地方。
content_en:

The idea of "stealing" entered Chen Ping's mind and stayed there.
Fear gripped him, making his hands and feet cold.
But then came the madness that comes from being hungry for three years.
If you don’t steal, you will starve to death.
If it is stolen, what if it can actually be grown?
What if this black soil can?
He thought of the hardwood stick he had whittled during the day.
It was a piece of edge he picked up from the scrap pile. It was hard and tough.
He spent a long time using the sharp-edged gravel to remove the burrs and bark and polish it smoother. Originally intended to defend myself or pry something.
Now, this one-foot-long hardwood stick has become his only tool.
He returned to the shack.
It was already dawn, and the shack area became noisy, with coughs and yells mixed together.
Chen Ping clenched the hardwood stick tightly, the wood grain scratching the palm of his hand. He tucked it into his trousers and covered it with his coat.
He needs to bide his time.
There are too many people during the day, so that won’t work.
The target can only be the outer perimeter of the spiritual field, which is less guarded at night. The spiritual grains grown there are of low grade and the guards are not that strict.
No one believed that these half-starved coolies dared to touch the immortal master's things.
Chen Ping spent the whole day in torment and excitement.
He worked like everyone else, pulling carts, moving rocks, and cleaning up debris.
I was very hungry, but what tortured me even more was that thought and the jade pendant in my arms. Every time he bent down, he subconsciously protected it, fearing that others would notice something strange.
I already have calluses on my hands, but my work is normal. Only the cut on his thumb, which was cut by a stone chip, hurt slightly, reminding him of what happened last night.
He didn't dare to look at the jade pendant anymore, he only thought about the night.
Finally called it a day.
The overseer distributed the rice.
Chen Ping wolfed down the food, forcing himself not to think about hunger, but only to think about the black soil.
Night falls again.
Chen Ping huddled in the darkest corner of the shack, listening to the outside.
The sound of people gradually diminished, leaving only sporadic coughs and the distant chirping of insects.
Time passes.
Chen Ping's heart was beating fast. He estimated that the patrolling guards had just passed through this area, and the next round would be half an hour later. This is his chance.
He got up quietly without disturbing the other sleeping people in the shack.
He touched the door, listened, pushed open a crack, stepped out, and closed the door again.
The night wind blew on my back, making it a bit cold.
The shack area is very quiet, with the occasional dog barking in the distance.
He followed the shadow of the shack and walked towards the outer spiritual field.
The moonlight was very pale, covered by clouds, and the ground was hazy. This gave him cover.
The road was uneven, so he stepped deeper and deeper, trying not to make any noise. Every time I stepped on something, I stopped immediately, lowered my body, and made sure there was no movement before continuing.
After walking for a quarter of an hour, the fragrance of Linggu became stronger in the air.
He saw the outline of the spiritual field, which looked like a black blanket in the moonlight.
There is a thatched shed beside the field ridge. Where the night watchman stays.
